start.label: Mörtfors / trail start about 1 km south of Mörtfors

start.confidence: high for route endpoint; low for exact shelter/toilet coordinate
evidence: Official description says the stage starts about 1 km south of Mörtfors.
OSM/Nominatim Mörtfors village node was measured about 1085 m from the GPX first point by the geometry agent.
OSM relation southern endpoint is about 743 m from the GPX first point, suggesting OSM includes extra Mörtfors approach geometry.
caveats: Do not use central Mörtfors as the section start coordinate.
The official start shelter/toilet exists per official facts, but its facility-specific coordinate is not verified.

OSM relation endpoint candidate was 36 m from the GPX last point in the geometry pass.
caveats: Use the specific shelter/toilet facility coordinates for POI imports rather than the line endpoint.

issues.notes: OSM southern/eastern endpoint near Mörtfors is about 743 m from the official GPX first point.
OSM member graph splits into two components near Tällsjön because nodes do not connect exactly.
Likely a short spur/side connection rather than a main-route endpoint.
OSM relation member order is not traversal order and begins mid-route. Do not infer direction from member order.

shapeSimilarity.caveat: Vertex-nearest comparison only; deviations reflect OSM extra start approach/spurs and different simplification.

shelterCamping: Official sources state timber shelters at the start and end of Etapp 1.
The Getgölen/Lilla Getgöl shelter coordinate is high-confidence and importable.
The Mörtfors start shelter/toilet exists in official facts but its exact coordinate remains pending.
The mid-stage ArkNat shelter Vandraren at Tällsjön is current enough to import as a candidate facility.
fire: Mörtfors naturreservat rules allow fires only at designated places, in a brought grill, or outdoor stove.
Trail manager tells hikers to check current fire-ban status through SMHI, Länsstyrelsen, or municipality before lighting fires.
Do not import unsourced fireplaces outside official/designated places.
waste: Current Naturskyddsforeningen guidance says there is no trash collection on the trail; hikers should pack out all rubbish.
Older Etapp 1 PDF trash-bag references are stale compared with current trail-manager guidance.
campingRestrictions: Mörtfors naturreservat rules allow no more than one day of camping in the same place.
openQuestions: Confirm whether the GPX start coordinate lies inside Mörtfors naturreservat boundary or only adjacent to it.
Verify exact start shelter/toilet and any designated fire-place coordinates.

protectedAreas.name: Mörtfors naturreservat
protectedAreas.relevance: Section 1 starts near/through the Mörtfors area; Länsstyrelsen says the reserve is reachable on foot via both Ostkustleden and Tjustleden.
rules: Fires only at designated places, in brought grill, or outdoor stove.
No camping more than one day in the same place.
Do not disturb wildlife; do not approach raptor nests, dens, or burrows.
Do not pick/damage mosses, lichens, wood fungi; do not damage/remove living or dead wood.
protectedAreas.currentStatus: Länsstyrelsen page says no current news for this visitor site as accessed 2026-04-29.
protectedAreas.caveat: Exact intersection with the GPX line needs GIS overlay.

dogsLivestockAndHunting.notes: Mörtfors naturreservat requires leashes. In Kalmar län generally, Länsstyrelsen states stricter dog-control rules from 1 March to 20 August.
dogsLivestockAndHunting.confidence: high for reserve/general rule; medium for exact route overlay

dogsLivestockAndHunting.notes: Route passes old agricultural/cultural landscape around Getterum. General official guidance: use gates/stiles, close gates, keep distance from grazing animals, keep dog leashed, avoid going between mother and young.
Allemansrätten applies during hunting, but hikers should not substantially disturb hunting; signs for active hunting should be treated as a practical warning to choose another area/route.

fireBanCurrentness.notes: Västervik municipality says brand-risk forecasts are based on SMHI and updated daily. Current fire ban must be checked near trip/import date.

Västervik fire pages conflict on built-up-area seasonal dates: one page says 1 May-30 September, another says 2 May-29 September. Avoid hardcoding these dates until confirmed from current regulation/feed.

terrainHazards: Stage follows Stora Ramm shoreline and includes passages near steep rock faces, boulders, lakeside rocks, and bathing rocks.
Older field reports mention fallen trees, brush, ticks, and occasionally difficult tread; these are not current-condition evidence but useful seasonal/context warnings.
No Etapp 1 bridge hazard was found in official sources checked.

closuresAndCurrentness.status: No Etapp 1-specific closure/reroute found on official acute information page as of 2026-04-29.
Current acute notices on the official page concerned Etapp 6 only, dated 2026-03-13, 2026-04-03, and 2026-04-17.

conditionReports.finding: No visible user reviews for this exact section; page shows 0/5 stars and a reviews section with no useful reports.
No acute Etapp 1 warning found. Active/current 2026 notices were for Etapp 6 around Lundaborg/Sixgöl.
Older report says Tjustleden was well marked but Etapp 1/early trail sometimes had rock, dense branches, fallen trees, high bushes, ticks, and segments that felt like bushwhacking.
Older report notes many ticks on Etapp 1 and describes reaching the Getgöl shelter by the lake.

conditionReports.reportDate: platform page crawled around 2026-02/2026-03; no individual review date visible
conditionReports.finding: General whole-trail page says the trail includes some swampy/damp places, but does not isolate Etapp 1.

researchIterations.method: Six parallel independent research agents plus main-thread synthesis.

agents.summary: Confirmed official identity, distance, difficulty, start about 1 km south of Mörtfors, endpoint shelters/TC, ArkNat Tällsjön, 2026 practical advice, current acute-info page, official downloads.
Compared official GPX, Naturkartan page, Smålandsleden mirror, and OSM relation 4767779. Recommended official GPX as primary geometry.
Found importable Getgöl shelter/toilet, ArkNat shelter, Samsvik viewpoint; flagged start shelter coordinate, bathing rocks, heritage sites, and water as pending/suppress/access metadata.
Identified Mörtfors E22 bus stop and end-side Bryggeriet/Getterum bus stop candidates with KLT network caveats.
Found limited recent user-generated reporting, no Naturkartan reviews, older 2005/2013 reports with ticks/brush/shelter notes, and official no-current-Etapp-1 alert evidence.
Found Mörtfors naturreservat restrictions, fire-ban check policy, dog/livestock/hunting guidance, no Etapp 1 acute closure, and water-carry guidance.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Good enough for a research-ready handoff file, but not import-ready without start-facility coordinate verification, official KLT stop/GTFS verification, protected-area overlay, and final fire-rule wording.

openQuestions: Verify the exact coordinate of the Mörtfors start shelter and TC; do not reuse the GPX start point as a facility coordinate without confirmation.
Confirm whether the GPX start coordinate lies inside Mörtfors naturreservat or only adjacent to it using GIS/protected-area overlay.
Confirm KLT stop coordinates and service patterns from official KLT GTFS/trip planner for Mörtfors E22, Bryggeriet, and Getterum.
Verify practical walking access distances from bus stops to start/end, not only straight-line distances.
Find precise coordinates for Stora Ramm/Tällsjön bathing rocks, Ramnesund ruin/cairn, Mörtfors hillfort/viewpoint, and Getterums by/Åsen if they are to become POIs.
Resolve Västervik fire-ban seasonal-date contradiction before encoding fixed seasonal rule text.
Check current official acute-information page again near import time.
